# Twiggli

> Twiggli is a Berlin platform for creative, hands-on workshops with local makers: pottery and ceramics, candle making, painting and drawing, screen printing and linocut, crafts, cooking, photography, wellbeing and music, run by independent hosts in their own studios. You can see the workshops on video before you book, with real dates and real prices. Twiggli also arranges private group bookings (team events, Christmas parties, hen parties) for groups of up to 1,000 people, rents out hosts' studios, and is opening the Twiggli Club. The site is in English and German, plus French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish and Turkish.

Twiggli is for people looking for community in Berlin. It brings them together with the city's makers: potters, candle makers, screen printers, sculptors, florists. Every booking through Twiggli supports a real person in Berlin, not a corporation.

## How booking works

- Every Book or Request button on the site opens a short booking request form, with the workshop, host, date and time already filled in. The request goes to Twiggli; the booking is made through Twiggli, not on the host's own page.
- Twiggli checks with the host and confirms the place by email. Sending a request costs nothing: there is nothing to pay until the place is confirmed.
- Group, company and studio requests work the same way: tell us about the group or the space you need, and we come back with options, dates and a quote.
- Full dates have a waiting list.
- Contact: hello@twiggli.com

## Find a workshop

- [Workshops in Berlin](https://www.twiggli.com/workshops/): all workshops by activity, with upcoming dates, prices and booking. German: [Workshops in Berlin](https://www.twiggli.com/de/workshops/)
- [What's on today and this week](https://www.twiggli.com/happening-today/): every workshop running in Berlin today and over the coming weeks, with times, prices and spots left. German: [Workshops heute](https://www.twiggli.com/de/happening-today/)
- [Pottery and ceramics](https://www.twiggli.com/workshops/ceramics/): wheel throwing, handbuilding and glazing with independent ceramicists. German: [Töpferkurs Berlin](https://www.twiggli.com/de/workshops/ceramics/)
- [Painting, drawing and printmaking](https://www.twiggli.com/workshops/art/): linocut, screen printing, cyanotype, portrait drawing, sketching walks, painting. German: [Kunst und Druck](https://www.twiggli.com/de/workshops/art/)
- [Craft and DIY](https://www.twiggli.com/workshops/craft/): candle making, rug tufting, soap, quilting, knitting, blacksmithing, whittling, silversmithing. German: [Kreativkurse](https://www.twiggli.com/de/workshops/craft/)
- [Cooking and food](https://www.twiggli.com/workshops/food/): sushi, kimchi, pasta, sourdough, coffee roasting, foraging, tastings. German: [Kochkurse](https://www.twiggli.com/de/workshops/food/)
- [Photography](https://www.twiggli.com/workshops/photography/): analog film, darkroom, cyanotype. German: [Fotokurse](https://www.twiggli.com/de/workshops/photography/)
- [Wellbeing](https://www.twiggli.com/workshops/wellbeing/): breathwork, movement, voice, mindfulness, creative writing. German: [Achtsamkeit](https://www.twiggli.com/de/workshops/wellbeing/)
- [Music](https://www.twiggli.com/workshops/music/): handpan, cajon, percussion, drumming. German: [Musik](https://www.twiggli.com/de/workshops/music/)
- [Weekend workshops](https://www.twiggli.com/workshops/weekend/), [evening workshops](https://www.twiggli.com/workshops/evenings/) and [workshops for kids](https://www.twiggli.com/workshops/kids/). German: [Wochenende](https://www.twiggli.com/de/workshops/weekend/), [Abends](https://www.twiggli.com/de/workshops/evenings/), [Kinder](https://www.twiggli.com/de/workshops/kids/)

## Groups and companies

- [Team event ideas in Berlin](https://www.twiggli.com/team-events-berlin/), [Christmas party ideas in Berlin](https://www.twiggli.com/christmas-party-ideas-berlin/), [Team building in Berlin](https://www.twiggli.com/team-building-berlin/), [Offsite activities in Berlin](https://www.twiggli.com/offsite-activities-berlin/): every host who takes private groups, with group sizes, prices per person and whether they come to your office, plus 60–90 minute creative breaks at your venue. German: [Teamevents](https://www.twiggli.com/de/team-events-berlin/), [Weihnachtsfeier-Ideen](https://www.twiggli.com/de/christmas-party-ideas-berlin/), [Teambuilding](https://www.twiggli.com/de/team-building-berlin/), [Offsite](https://www.twiggli.com/de/offsite-activities-berlin/)
- [Team building and corporate bookings](https://www.twiggli.com/corporatebookings/): team events, Christmas parties and large company events in Berlin for groups of up to 1,000 people, at a host's studio or at your venue. One host or many, one invoice. German: [Firmenbuchungen](https://www.twiggli.com/de/corporatebookings/)
- [Christmas party workshops](https://www.twiggli.com/weihnachtsfeier/): private workshops for a team's Christmas party, with options and a quote within 24 hours. German: [Weihnachtsfeier mit Workshop](https://www.twiggli.com/de/weihnachtsfeier/)
- [Hen party in Berlin](https://www.twiggli.com/jga/): private creative workshops for 4 to 20 friends, ideas within 24 hours. German: [JGA Berlin](https://www.twiggli.com/de/jga/)
- [Birthday party in Berlin](https://www.twiggli.com/birthday/): private creative workshops for 4 to 20 guests, adults or kids, ideas within 24 hours. German: [Geburtstag feiern in Berlin](https://www.twiggli.com/de/birthday/)

## Spaces and hosts

- [Studio rental](https://www.twiggli.com/studio-rental/): rent a Berlin maker studio by the hour or the day for your own workshop, a shoot, a team session or a private party. German: [Raum mieten](https://www.twiggli.com/de/studio-rental/)
- [Become a host](https://www.twiggli.com/host/): for makers who run workshops in Berlin. Twiggli shows the class on video, lists the dates and passes booking requests on. No account, no listing fee. German: [Host werden](https://www.twiggli.com/de/host/)

## About

- [About Twiggli](https://www.twiggli.com/about/): why Twiggli exists and where the name comes from. German: [Über Twiggli](https://www.twiggli.com/de/ueber-uns/)
- [Twiggli Club](https://www.twiggli.com/club/): a members' club in Berlin, opening soon: one workshop a month with a Berlin maker, The Twiggli Letter by post and members-only evenings. German: [Twiggli Club](https://www.twiggli.com/de/club/)
- [Contact](https://www.twiggli.com/contact/): hosting, corporate events or anything else, hello@twiggli.com. German: [Kontakt](https://www.twiggli.com/de/contact/)
- [Home](https://www.twiggli.com/). German: [Startseite](https://www.twiggli.com/de/)
